header.name: Outdoor table with parasol V2
header.description: A 7 ft x 3 ft white oak top on yellow painted angle-iron legs, with a rectangular frame, a centre beam and a low back bar. A folding red parasol with one large canopy at the far end, on a square base with two sandbags. A bonsai in a 2 ft box on the ground, 8 ft from the table, reaching over it.
